changelog:
- Initial release of the novel-reviewer skill: a comprehensive, multi-dimensional novel evaluation tool.
- Assesses novels across 10 weighted categories including plot, characters, writing quality, pacing, originality, and more.
- Produces a total score out of 10 with corresponding quality tier and detailed feedback (strengths, weaknesses, suggestions).
- Designed for book reviews, creative feedback, and novel assessment in various contexts.
- Clear evaluation format provided for consistent, actionable reporting.
summary: Multi-dimensional novel evaluation based on provided content, assessing across plot, characters, writing quality, worldbuilding, pacing, originality, emotion...
